referenceImages.role: Primary style master: original M, with broad ribbon weight, soft asymmetric joins and rounded-flat terminals.
Older S: full recognizable S body and soft ribbon curves, not its generic roundness.
Angular take: disciplined outer sections and a narrower middle; do not copy its lightning-bolt silhouette or narrow visual weight.

userDrawing.role: Preserved construction context; the user now requests a blend, not a literal drawing trace.

generationPolicy: One image per sequential Fgen call. Inspect every saved alternative before the next. Preserve all raw outputs and rejection history. No pixel cleanup, raster warping, contour repair or vector replacement. The user chooses the final S.

previousDirections.decision: User rejected the first rounded refinement.
User rejected the thin and heavy angular takes as outside the font style; requests a combination with the older S.

balanced.label: S1 / Balanced blend
balanced.brief: BALANCED BLEND: roughly two-thirds of the older S's full soft ribbon body and one-third of the angular take's disciplined sides. Clearly recognizable S; quieter straighter outside sections, narrow but still bold waist, softly flattened terminals.
balanced.prompt: Create ONE uppercase S by BLENDING the older rounded S in Image 2 with the angular S in Image 3. Image 1, our original M, is the PRIMARY FONT STYLE: use its broad heavy ribbons, subtle asymmetry, compact soft joins and rounded-flat terminals. Keep the older S's recognizable full two-bowl body and generous ribbon mass. Introduce disciplined near-straight sections on the upper-left and lower-right outside contours, and a modestly thinner middle waist from the angular take. Join these sections with M-like soft turns: a cohesive typeface S, not a lightning bolt or zigzag symbol. The middle stays substantial, about two-thirds of the side-ribbon thickness. Preserve broad strokes as heavy as M at equal cap height; make the letter wider rather than thin. Both S apertures remain open. Solid WHITE filled letter on pure BLACK square, centered with generous clear margins. Only one S, no labels, outlines or decorations.
